description: Expanded Full Evaluation Dataset for Vishleshan AI v2 constructed under Phase 6B-2B across 4 sampling strata.
provenance_policy: Strict multi-source provenance tracking with mandatory URLs, retrieval timestamps, publisher authority ratings, and verbatim quotes.
annotation_policy: Double-blind human annotation with anonymized IDs (ANN-1042, ANN-2091). Zero model-assisted or LLM predictions permitted in ground truth. Raw annotation decision logs preserved in annotation_audit/.
